name: Molecular Generation Benchmark for Bioactive Compound Design
description: A rigorous statistical benchmark comparing molecular generation methods across drug, agrochemical, and small-molecule datasets for bioactive compound design.
evaluation_method: composite multi-objective scoring (validity, novelty, uniqueness, property-based objectives, synthesizability, diversity)
general_score_metric: composite_score combining validity/novelty/uniqueness and property-optimization metrics
typical_sota_score: varies by dataset and objective; unknown
reputation: Recent rigorous preprint benchmark (2025) beginning to be referenced in cheminformatics and drug-design method comparisons but not yet a de facto standard.
notes: Non-LLM benchmark; evaluation relies on surrogate property predictors and chosen objectives, which can bias comparisons; results sensitive to dataset selection and scoring choices.
